name: product-marketing-cli
description: Exercise #9 - Product Description Generator (CLI): analyses product images with a multimodal LLM and generates grounded marketing content.

scripts.demo:bottle: python3 product_marketing.py --images samples/bottle_1.jpg samples/bottle_2.jpg --info "Stainless-steel insulated bottle, 750 ml, keeps drinks cold for 24 hours" --tone friendly --slogans 3 --output bottle_content.md
scripts.demo:shoe: python3 product_marketing.py --images samples/shoe_1.jpg --info "Water-resistant hiking shoe for autumn and winter" --tone professional --slogans 5 --output shoe_content.md
